python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, re
root = "slack-api"
files = []
for dirpath, _, names in os.walk(root):
    for n in names:
        files.append(os.path.join(dirpath, n))

content = open(os.path.join(root, "SKILL.md"), encoding="utf-8").read()
assert content.startswith("---"), "no frontmatter"
parts = content.split("---")
assert len(parts) >= 3, "invalid frontmatter"
fm = parts[1]
name = re.search(r"^name:\s*(.+)$", fm, re.M).group(1).strip()
desc = re.search(r"^description:\s*(?:'([^']*)'|\"([^\"]*)\"|(.+))$", fm, re.M)
desc_text = next((g for g in desc.groups() if g is not None), "").strip()
assert re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9-]+", name), f"bad name {name}"
assert "\n" not in desc_text, "description multi-line"
assert len(desc_text) <= 1024, "description too long"
bad = [f for f in files if "TODO:" in open(f, encoding="utf-8").read()]
assert not bad, f"TODOs in {bad}"
print("name:", name)
print("desc len:", len(desc_text))
print("files:", files)
print("VALID: all checks passed")
EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile, os
out = "slack-api.skill"
with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for dirpath, _, names in os.walk("slack-api"):
        for n in sorted(names):
            full = os.path.join(dirpath, n)
            z.write(full, os.path.relpath(full, "slack-api"))
print("created", out, os.path.getsize(out), "bytes")
with zipfile.ZipFile(out) as z:
    for i in z.infolist():
        print(" ", i.filename)
EOF
